name: doc_writing_supervisor_variable
description: This variable holds the result of the create_team_supervisor function, which sets up a supervisor agent for managing document writing tasks.

name: create_team_supervisor_function_call
description: This expression calls the create_team_supervisor function with parameters that define the supervisor's role and the team members involved in the document writing process.
full_code: create_team_supervisor(llm, ("You are a supervisor tasked with managing a conversation between the" " following workers: {team_members}. You should always verify the technical" " contents after any edits are made. " "Given the following user request," " respond with the worker to act next. Each worker will perform a" " task and respond with their results and status. When each team is finished," " you must respond with FINISH."), ["DocWriter", "NoteTaker", "EmpathyEditor", "CopyEditor"],)
